Corrected: each linked customer's report timed from its own SEC 8-K Item 2.02 acceptance time (before 09:30 ET -> that session; during market hours -> that session; 16:00 or later -> the next session); no 8-K within 3 days -> the calendar rule. Rule, gates, links (same SHA), window, costs, yardsticks and placebo seed unchanged.
